scope: Verified and corroborated public EV locations around the actual retained route, northern section Coventry–Daventry–Weedon–Towcester. Focus on remaining route beyond approximately 35 km; existing passed MFG retained.
coverageNote: Broad current search of operator, council and retail records, not a guarantee of every charger or current availability. Private chargers excluded. Some near-route candidates have approximate car-park/station pins and need signed-entrance checks.
projectionNote: routeKm and routeOffsetM computed against public/data/route.geojson. Offset is straight-line, never a walking detour. Meeting eligibility uses <=300 m proximity plus access judgement, not a tested pedestrian route.
integrationNotes: Use existingFacilityId to merge rather than duplicate mixed toilet/parking locations.
Keep EV charging hours separate from toilet hours; do not overwrite existing opening/access with the charging schedule.
Bowen Square is the preferred next EV choice, not an instruction to overwrite the currently agreed meetup.
Stations beyond 300 m or with unconfirmed operation are supporter backups/list-only rather than default runner meeting choices.
Do not copy prices or snapshot availability as live truth.
Do not infer toilets from a charger being open all night.
